messages:
nightly-eval-bot: nightly eval finished for rwd-llama3-large-fp8 (fp8-legacy profile). Alert: +7.3% failure rate on math_prompts_v2 vs int8-baseline, regression surfaced in quality/regressions/quant.
maya: ugh. any cheap examples? which metric bubbled up?
nightly-eval-bot: metrics: exact_match -7.3, token_acc -4.1, rouge-l -2.5. Failing buckets: long_math (len>1024), safety_edgecases.
kevin: pasted two diffs from failing runs:
```
# prompt
"Calculate integral of x^2 from 0 to 3"
# int8
"The integral of x^2 is x^3/3. Evaluate from 0 to 3 gives 9."
# fp8
"The integral is 6.75 because 3 squared is 6.75"  <-- wrong / hallucinated scalar
```
kevin: similar pattern for a handful of arithmetic and date reasoning prompts, hallucinated constants.
sasha: any changes in the quant calibration pipeline recently? calib set, per-channel vs per-tensor, symmetric vs asymmetric?
ammar: last deploy changed fp8 quant scale smoothing (beta=0.02 -> 0.1) and switched per-channel scaling on matmuls; could affect outliers.
maya: does the nightly-run use the same calibration corpus as staging? maybe the small nightly calib is biased.
kevin: looking at quant_stats: some channels show scale collapse (very small scale) for FFN weights; that amplifies rounding error. grabbing logs now.
ops-bot: run link: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/2026-03-19/rl3-fp8-1779001110 logs: /artifacts/rl3-fp8/quant_stats.json
sasha: i'll repro locally with the full calibration set and no smoothing. plan:
1) rerun calibrate with calib_full_v2 (5k prompts)
2) eval math_prompts_v2 and long_math slices (seeded)
3) dump logits + token-by-token diff vs int8 baseline
4) if persistent, test fp8-safe profile (per-tensor + beta=0.01)
kevin: also check KV-cache path. fp8 path had a separate kernel for KV fusion; differences there could magnify errors for long contexts.
ammar: good call. if this is contextual drift then short-contexts won't show it. nightly alerted long_math bucket primarily.
maya: can you own the repro? create an eng-ml ticket and tag me.
sasha: assigning to myself. ETA ~4h, will post quick artifact link. disabling per-channel on matmul as a quick toggle to test.
kevin: suggested command for repro (use this):
```
./tools/run_eval --model rwd-llama3-large --quant-profile fp8-legacy \
  --calib-set calib_full_v2.json --smoothing 0.01 --slices long_math,math_prompts_v2 \
  --seed 42 --dump logits,diffs --out /tmp/fp8-repro/1779001110
```
maya: :eyes: thanks. if repro matches, we should revert fp8 smoothing change and publish a hotfix profile to dedicated.
ammar: also add a small unit test for scale-collapse detection in nightly-calib to catch this earlier.
ops-bot: scheduled job created: ci/repro-fp8-1779001110 (queued on gpu-pool-2). link: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/ci/repro-fp8-1779001110
sasha: initial quick run finished: I'm seeing the same hallucinated constants in ~18/200 samples. dumping artifacts now: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/1779001110/fp8-repro.tar.gz
kevin: grabbing logits diff. preliminary hist: fp8 logits variance increased in FFN layers by ~1.8x relative to int8.
maya: ok next steps: (a) run full 5k eval (b) test fp8-safe profile (c) if fixes, ship emergency profile and rollback the beta change.
ammar: i'll open the rollback PR for the smoothing param and ping infra for canary deploy window.
sasha: will update thread with final numbers when full eval completes. :party_parrot:
